# Why is my email being clipped?
## AI Overview
Clipping typically occurs when your email exceeds 102 KB on desktop or varies between 20 KB to 75 KB on mobile devices.

## About Gmail clipping
On desktop devices, the email size limit is generally 102 KB.

## What Counts Toward Gmail’s 102KB Limit
Gmail clips messages larger than roughly **102KB**.

## How To Check Your Email’s Real Size
- Over 102KB, expect Gmail to clip and hide content behind a link

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What size does Gmail clip emails at?
Around 102KB of message source.
